components.name: Install Command
components.description: A copyable package command for rails and documentation handoffs.
components.css: .ds-install-command { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.5rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #bcc7d6); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem; color: #263247; background: var(--surface, #fff); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-install-command code { font-family: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.79rem; } .ds-install-command svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-install-command:hover { border-color: #8e99aa; background: #f8f9fb; } .ds-install-command:active { background: var(--surface-muted, #f1f4f8); } .ds-install-command:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(103 92 245 / 32%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The committed action for loading a source or continuing to documentation.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary-action" type="button">Load manifest<svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.5rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--indigo, #675cf5); border-radius: 7px; padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem; color: #fff; background: var(--indigo, #675cf5); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease-out, background-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-primary-action svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-primary-action:hover { border-color: var(--indigo-dark, #5145df); background: var(--indigo-dark, #5145df); } .ds-primary-action:active { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(103 92 245 / 32%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pet Option
components.description: A source row with thumbnail, atlas metadata, and explicit selected state.
components.css: .ds-pet-option { display: grid; width: 100%; min-height: 3.6rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; grid-template-columns: 2.75rem minmax(0, 1fr) 0.6rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; padding: 0.35rem 0.45rem; text-align: left; color: var(--ink, #101828); background: transparent; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease-out, background-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-pet-option:hover { background: var(--surface-muted, #f1f4f8); } .ds-pet-option[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #a9a2ff; background: var(--indigo-soft, #efeeff); } .ds-pet-option:active { filter: brightness(0.98); } .ds-pet-option:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(103 92 245 / 32%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pet-thumbnail { display: grid; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #bdb7ff; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--indigo-dark, #5145df); background: var(--indigo-soft, #efeeff); font-family: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-pet-copy { min-width: 0; } .ds-pet-copy strong, .ds-pet-copy small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pet-copy strong { font-size: 0.78rem; } .ds-pet-copy small { margin-top: 0.16rem; color: var(--quiet, #778197); font-size: 0.65rem; } .ds-selection-marker { width: 0.48rem; height: 0.48rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--indigo, #675cf5); }

components.name: State Button
components.description: A compact atlas-row control that keeps state name and frame contract visible.
components.css: .ds-state-button { display: grid; width: 100%; min-height: 2.8rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; grid-template-columns: 1.7rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e0ea); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.45rem 0.55rem; text-align: left; color: var(--ink, #101828); background: var(--surface, #fff); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease-out, background-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-state-button:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #bcc7d6); background: var(--surface-muted, #f1f4f8); } .ds-state-button[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #a9a2ff; background: var(--indigo-soft, #efeeff); } .ds-state-button:active { filter: brightness(0.98); } .ds-state-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(103 92 245 / 32%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-state-row, .ds-state-button small { color: var(--quiet, #778197); font-family: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.62rem; } .ds-state-button strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: 0.74rem; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-state-button small { font-size: 0.58rem; } .ds-state-marker { width: 0.48rem; height: 0.48rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--indigo, #675cf5); }

components.css: .ds-source-disclosure { border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e0ea); border-radius: 9px; color: var(--ink, #101828); background: var(--surface, #fff); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-source-disclosure summary { display: grid; min-height: 2.65rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; grid-template-columns: 1rem minmax(0, 1fr) 0.9rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-source-disclosure summary:hover { background: var(--surface-muted, #f1f4f8); } .ds-source-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(103 92 245 / 32%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-source-disclosure summary svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-source-disclosure .ds-chevron { transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-source-disclosure[open] summary { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e0ea); background: var(--surface-muted, #f1f4f8); } .ds-source-disclosure[open] .ds-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-disclosure-body { padding: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted, #566174); font-size: 0.68rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Manifest Input
components.description: A compact source field with a persistent technical label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; color: var(--muted, #566174); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #bcc7d6); border-radius: 7px; padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem; color: var(--ink, #101828); background: var(--surface, #fff); font: inherit; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #667085; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #8e99aa; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(103 92 245 / 32%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field input:active { border-color: var(--indigo, #675cf5); }

components.name: Workbench Container
components.description: The shared bordered surface that joins source tools, artifact stage, inspector, and frame evidence.
components.css: .ds-workbench { display: grid; overflow: hidden; grid-template-areas: "source stage inspector" "frames frames frames"; grid-template-columns: minmax(8rem, 0.78fr) minmax(14rem, 2.25fr) minmax(9rem, 0.88fr); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #bcc7d6); border-radius: 14px; color: var(--ink, #101828); background: var(--surface, #fff); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-workbench aside { min-height: 9rem; padding: 1rem; } .ds-workbench aside:first-child { grid-area: source; border-right: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e0ea); } .ds-workbench aside:nth-child(3) { grid-area: inspector; border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e0ea); } .ds-workbench-stage { display: grid; min-height: 9rem; grid-area: stage; place-items: center; color: #c4ccdb; background-color: var(--stage, #0c111d); background-image: conic-gradient(from 90deg at 1px 1px, #101725 25%, #0c111d 0 50%, #101725 0 75%, #0c111d 0); background-size: 1rem 1rem; } .ds-workbench footer { grid-area: frames; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #bcc7d6); padding: 0.75rem 1rem; color: var(--quiet, #778197); font-family: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.67rem; } @media (max-width: 42rem) { .ds-workbench { grid-template-areas: "stage" "source" "inspector" "frames"; grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-workbench aside:first-child, .ds-workbench aside:nth-child(3) { border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e0ea); border-right: 0; border-left: 0; } }

narrative.overview:
The Open Workbench is a precise, approachable environment for developers who need to see an atlas work before they trust it. Its cool-light shell and contiguous white panes make the interface feel like a mature browser tool, while the dark pixel stage gives the animated artifact a clear place of consequence.

The system is compact without feeling cramped. Crisp dividers, measured controls, restrained indigo selection, and explicit emerald or red status feedback make relationships legible without turning the product into a themed dashboard. Brand character comes from proportion, exact state design, and the contrast between quiet tooling and vivid pixel artwork.
keyCharacteristics: Cool-light application shell with contiguous white working surfaces.
Dark, gridded stages that isolate and dignify pixel artwork.
Indigo for selection and action; emerald and red only for operational status.
Dense, exact controls supported by generous space around the primary artifact.
Crisp rules and tonal layering instead of decorative surface effects.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the only interactive accent; semantic green and red communicate state and never compete for navigation or selection.

rules.name: The Artifact Contrast Rule
rules.body: Pixel artwork belongs on the dark stage; controls and explanatory content stay on light surfaces.

rules.name: The Functional Mono Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only when the content is executable, numeric, versioned, or structurally exact; prose and ordinary labels remain system UI.

rules.name: The Singular Brand Face Rule
rules.body: Avenir Next is a product-name accent, not a heading system.

rules.name: The Contiguous Tool Rule
rules.body: Related controls and previews share one bordered working surface, with dividers carrying hierarchy inside it.

rules.name: The Artifact-First Reflow Rule
rules.body: On narrow screens, place the live artifact before its controls while keeping the controls in their causal order.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces do not cast shadows; depth appears only where live state or the artifact itself needs separation.

dos: Do let the live artifact dominate any operational surface built from this system.
Do use contiguous light panes and one-pixel rules to show relationships between tools.
Do reserve Workbench Indigo for action, selection, focus, and current playback state.
Do keep pixel artwork crisp and place it on a dark, low-contrast grid when it needs inspection.
Do pair exact atlas facts with monospace while keeping explanatory language in system UI.
Do keep motion short and state-driven, and honor reduced-motion preferences for ornamental transitions.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a generic marketing hero before the working artifact appears.
Don't scatter related controls into elevated cards or decorate every surface with shadows.
Don't use Avenir Next beyond the product brand or use monospace as a general interface voice.
Don't use emerald or crimson as competing action colors.
Don't smooth pixel canvases, crop exact frame evidence, or hide operational errors in transient decoration.
